scope: Non-product candidate selection only. No actions were proposed or executed and no game engine was run for this audit.

provenance.decode: Read the publicly published gallery atlases with the publicly declared default palette. Verify each atlas SHA256 and each decoded 64x64 palette-index raster SHA256 against its manifest entry.
provenance.measurements: Apply only existing pure scene-measurement functions to the verified rasters, with no learned controls, no family proposals, no trajectories, no action selection and no physical game actions.
provenance.data_boundary: No hidden engine state, authored level source, solution, oracle path, replay or fixed input sequence was read or supplied to a live agent.

coverage.skipped_reason: A different palette prevents this exact default-palette decoding. A skipped frame is not evidence that its game is unsupported.

ranked_candidates.name: Elastic Grid
ranked_candidates.bootstrap: The existing source proposal reconciles the visible partition, selects a tile through ACTION6 and proposes a conditional transfer. It needs no preloaded motion facts. The first unmeasured transfer seals the prefix.
premises: A unique irregular rectangular partition with at least two foreground colors.
A separate homologous target raster at a possible uniform scale.
ACTION6 and sufficient public remaining-action budget at runtime.
A target whose currently visible inventory is sufficient for a bounded conditional search.
limits: Geometry recognition does not establish target admissibility or a solution.
Hidden underlayers are unknown and are learned only when exposed by actual physical actions.
Initial policy direction vectors are explicitly conditional hypotheses, never observed game controls.
Original search budget is4096 states; successful search and common-router ownership remain to be observed.
ranked_candidates.prior_proof: Original family parity fixture includes13 steps for target selection, transfer fit, exact guards and an official boundary; this is a synthetic contract, not an ELAS common-agent campaign.

ranked_candidates.bootstrap: The existing source proposal initializes from public layout, calibrates actual axial inputs, learns the active rigid material, then selects materials and attempts joint port matching.
premises: A uniquely measurable repeated marker lattice with disjoint material ownership.
At least two plain input commands and an addressed input in the common input domain.
Observable motion sufficient to identify the active material and its translations.
limits: Motion, port ownership after selection, rotation and editing overlap require observed responses.
An initial layout match does not establish that common priority routing reaches the family or that three levels can be solved.
ranked_candidates.prior_proof: Synthetic source contracts cover26 steps of calibration and joint matching,4 rotation/ambiguity steps and9 selection/overlay steps; no fresh common-agent CN04 campaign established here.

ranked_candidates.bootstrap: The family requires ordinary common exploration to observe an actor translation and a frontal contour invitation before it becomes ready. It subsequently learns co-translation and release through observed effects.
premises: Repeated hollow square objects with a unique shared pitch and phase.
A homologous goal enclosure with sufficient measured slots.
Actual observed controller translation and a new frontal contour.
limits: Pure initial geometry is insufficient to activate the proposal.
The source interaction candidate and initial direction mappings remain hypotheses.
Common exploration may not establish the required invitation within the campaign budget.
ranked_candidates.prior_proof: A 21 step synthetic source contract covers public invitation, rigid-coupling proof, route and release; this is not a WA30 success result.

other_evidence_limits.AS66: Existing 3 level standalone evidence includes 16 externally imposed public probes; it does not prove unprimed common-agent success.
other_evidence_limits.GLOB: Existing standalone evidence is 1 level with 4 externally imposed probes.
other_evidence_limits.MEMO: Standalone 3 level proof coexists with 0 level common-agent evidence; do not claim it as a solved common campaign.
other_evidence_limits.RE86: First three public previews match constellation geometry, but acquisition is longer and not selected before ELAS/CN04/WA30.

actual_campaign_requirements: Start at level1 with fresh native common-agent memory.
Every physical action, including calibration, must come from the ordinary common caller.
Do not prime from the preview scan or parity fixtures, preload controls, branch on game IDs, jump levels or inject resets.
Freeze implementation and policy before replay.
Only observed official level progression or WIN authorizes a resolution claim.
